ná-ga, m. mountain;
 tree.

nagar-in, m. head of the city.

*nāgarī, f. = deva-nāgarī.
nagar-īya, a. urban.
nagara‿upānta, n. neighbourhood 🞄of the town.
nagara‿okas, m. citizen.

nagnaṃ-bhā́vuka, a. becoming 🞄naked, disrobing shamelessly.
nagna‿aṭa, m. naked Jain mendicant.
nagn-ikā, f. girl become menstruation.
nagnī-kṛ, turn into a naked mendicant.

nāga-rāj, m. serpent king;
 -rāja, -rājan, m. id..
nāgī-bhū, turn into a Nāga.
na‿agni-dūṣita, pp. uninjured 🞄by fire.
